code_summary: One causal NextItNet with 64 hidden units, maximum sequence length 128, and eight residual blocks using dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8]. Each block contains two left-padded kernel-3 convolutions, pre-layer normalization, GELU, and dropout 0.2. The encoder combines normalized item embeddings with learned positions, masks padding after each block, and applies final layer and L2 normalization. Training and candidate scoring use raw tied item embeddings without temperature scaling. Host hyperparameters: Adam learning rate 0.001, weight decay 0, batch size 128.
